adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the sync path posts `calcomUserId: userId.toString()` and is invoked when `... && userId` is truthy. In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new call is `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)`, whereas other adapters in the diff pass `credential.userId`. This is a verifiable mismatch: the third argument is intended to be a Cal.com user id for the sync endpoint, but zoho-bigin passes a different identifier (`credentialId`), which would cause the sync endpoint to resolve the wrong/nonexistent user and could lead to updating the wrong credential/user mapping when credential sharing is enabled.
